Queensland Rail dispute resolved, services to resume

Queensland Rail and seven unions have reached a pay agreement, ending a long-running dispute that caused months of commuter delays. The resolution means the rail network is expected to return to normal operations. Specific details of the pay agreement were not immediately disclosed.
